func_use.label: Nonionic surfactant
func_use.description: Mild surfactants without charge, often used in household cleaners.

func_use.label: Anionic surfactant
func_use.description: Negatively charged surfactants, strong cleaners and foamers.

func_use.label: Cationic surfactant
func_use.description: Positively charged surfactants, often used in disinfectants and fabric softeners.

func_use.label: Amphoteric surfactant
func_use.description: Surfactants that can carry positive or negative charge depending on pH.

func_use.label: Surfactant (unspecified type)
func_use.description: Surfactant use where the ionic type is not clearly specified.

func_use.label: Water solvent
func_use.description: Water used as the primary carrier/solvent in the formulation.

func_use.label: Alcohol solvent
func_use.description: Short-chain alcohols like ethanol or isopropanol used for solvency and evaporation.

func_use.label: Glycol solvent
func_use.description: Glycols or glycol ethers used as powerful co-solvents.

func_use.label: Citrus solvent
func_use.description: Citrus-derived solvents such as d-limonene.

func_use.label: Other solvent
func_use.description: Solvents that do not fit the other more specific categories.

func_use.label: Preservative
func_use.description: General preservation against microbial growth.

func_use.label: Isothiazolinone preservative
func_use.description: Isothiazolinone-type preservatives (e.g. MIT, CMIT).

func_use.label: Formaldehyde-releasing preservative
func_use.description: Preservatives that slowly release formaldehyde.

func_use.label: Organic acid preservative
func_use.description: Preservatives based on benzoic, sorbic, or other organic acids and their salts.

func_use.label: Paraben preservative
func_use.description: Paraben-type preservatives.

func_use.label: Chelating agent
func_use.description: Binds metal ions to improve cleaning performance and stability.

func_use.label: Sequestrant
func_use.description: General metal-ion sequestrant.

func_use.label: Buffering agent
func_use.description: Maintains pH within a desired range (e.g., citrate salts).

func_use.label: Acidic pH adjuster
func_use.description: Lowers pH (e.g., citric acid).

func_use.label: Basic pH adjuster
func_use.description: Raises pH (e.g., sodium hydroxide, sodium carbonate).

func_use.label: Neutralizing agent
func_use.description: Neutralizes acids or bases to reach a target pH.

func_use.label: Fragrance
func_use.description: Fragrance or perfume blend for scent.

func_use.label: Fragrance allergen
func_use.description: Individual fragrance component known to be an allergen.

func_use.label: Odor masking agent
func_use.description: Ingredient primarily used to mask or neutralize odors.

func_use.label: Colorant
func_use.description: Dyes or pigments added mainly for color.

func_use.label: Optical brightener
func_use.description: Makes surfaces or fabrics appear whiter/brighter under UV light.

func_use.label: Thickener
func_use.description: Increases viscosity or creates gel-like textures.

func_use.label: Viscosity modifier
func_use.description: Adjusts flow characteristics without necessarily thickening strongly.

func_use.label: Anti-static agent
func_use.description: Reduces static buildup on surfaces or fabrics.

func_use.label: Anti-foaming agent
func_use.description: Reduces or controls foam formation.

func_use.label: Foaming agent
func_use.description: Increases or stabilizes foam.

func_use.label: Corrosion inhibitor
func_use.description: Protects metal surfaces and equipment against corrosion.

func_use.label: Stabilizer
func_use.description: Improves product stability (e.g., against heat, light, or storage conditions).

func_use.label: Emulsifier
func_use.description: Helps mix oil and water phases into stable formulations.

func_use.label: Dispersing agent
func_use.description: Keeps particles evenly dispersed in the product.

func_use.label: Plasticizer
func_use.description: Improves flexibility or feel of films and residues.

func_use.label: Conditioning agent
func_use.description: Improves feel or surface properties (e.g., softness, gloss).

func_use.label: Antimicrobial agent
func_use.description: Provides antimicrobial effect without being a registered disinfectant.

func_use.label: Disinfectant active
func_use.description: EPA-registered disinfectant active intended to kill pathogens.

func_use.label: Bleaching agent
func_use.description: Whitens or removes stains via oxidation or other mechanisms.

func_use.label: Oxidizing agent
func_use.description: Provides oxidative action in cleaning or bleaching.

func_use.label: Reducing agent
func_use.description: Provides reductive chemistry in cleaning or stain removal.

func_use.label: Enzyme – amylase
func_use.description: Breaks down starch-based soils.

func_use.label: Enzyme – lipase
func_use.description: Breaks down fat- and oil-based soils.

func_use.label: Enzyme – protease
func_use.description: Breaks down protein-based soils.

func_use.label: Enzyme – cellulase
func_use.description: Acts on cellulose, used e.g. in laundry to maintain fabric appearance.

func_use.label: Enzyme – other
func_use.description: Other enzyme activity not covered by the more specific enzyme types.

func_use.label: Botanical extract
func_use.description: Plant-derived extract used for function or marketing.

func_use.label: Essential oil
func_use.description: Concentrated volatile plant oil used for scent or solvency.

func_use.label: Plant-based solvent
func_use.description: Solvent primarily derived from plant sources.

func_use.label: Unknown function
func_use.description: Function could not be confidently classified.

func_use.label: Unverified function
func_use.description: Function suspected but not yet fully verified or researched.
